question.problem: Find the greatest common divisor of $2\,522$ and $1\,092.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}2\,522 & = & 1\,092(2) & + & 338 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 1\,092 & = & 338(3) & + & 78 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 338 & = & 78(4) & + & 26 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 78 & = & 26(3) & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $26.$ Therefore, we conclude that the greatest common divisor of $2\,522$ and $1\,092$ is $26.$ Symbolically, we write

$$
\text{gcd}(2\,522,1\,092)=26.
$$
